title: DUMBKIN
body:
DUMBKIN – Replace pumpkins with dumbkins!

Tired of normal pumpkins? Of course you are. That’s why DUMBKIN exists!! the silliest, most questionably necessary resource pack ever created. It takes your ordinary respectable pumpkins and turns them into absolute goofballs :D Whether you’re carving them wearing them or just letting them rot in your storage chest for months DUMBKIN gives them the personality they never asked for lol.

Each pumpkin now features a derpy glow up with a bold ridiculous design that makes every block look like it’s up to something mischievous, like goofy the memes on the internet. Jack o’Lanterns shine with extra attitude perfect for adding a bit of Halloween flavored nonsense to your world all year long.

This pack doesnt add new sounds models or fancy shaders just good old silly dumbkin chaos. It’s lightweight stupidly fun and works great alongside any other resource pack.

So go ahead replace your serious elegant pumpkin textures with these absolute clowns from the internet.
They’re dumb. They’re pumpkins. They’re DUMBKIN. (this sounds like an infomercial lol)
